answer: Vest every reward over 30 epochs and let a blind auditor compare each identity's answers against its neighbors for timing and phrasing overlap. A harbor of clones sharing one operator shows the same signal, so a flagged cluster forfeits all unvested pay at once. Honest agents lose nothing, while an attacker running N fakes must front N months of unpaid inference, and a raven-style tip from any insider can trigger the audit.
